harmonised_models.E5_common_mode_s10: 10% corrupted encounters shift -0.20 + N(0, 0.10^2) for all

E_misrouting_exact.note: expectation of Phi((theta2 - rho)/sigma) over the seed-42 Safe stratum; the closed form of Eq. (guard) assumes rho uniform on [0.7, 1]

G_threshold_extended.model: Fast vs Normal: rho*H*eta_N >= 2c + q_N*B (q_N = false-block probability of G2/G3 on a harmless action, B = cost of a false block); Normal vs Safe: rho*H*eta_S >= c + A + q_S*B (q_S = 0 here: approval and G4 add no automated block). Three tiers are optimal only if theta1* < theta2*; otherwise the Normal tier is never cost-optimal.
G_threshold_extended.q_N_source: 8.8% firing on unmodified Normal-pathway prescriptions (Table realchecks) as an upper bound

H_delay_closed_form.formula: P(fallback) = P(T1 > D) * P(T2 > D - W); P(escalate) = P(T1 > W); T ~ lognormal(ln m, 1)

I_latency_bound.note: G3 with 8 servers is the bottleneck: throughput <= 8 / E[S3] (Flat-4) and 8 / (0.65 E[S3]) (ORASR)

D_router_equivalence.scope: replicate 0 of every error model x mitigations M0-M3 through ORASRRouter.route
